name: Meditative Incantation
body:
You can meditate to un-prepare a spell.

Prerequisite: Int 13

Benefit: You are capable of taking 15 minutes of meditation to “erase” a prepared spell. The spell slot the erased spell used to occupy is then open and can be filled with a new prepared spell. This feat is only useful to spellcasters who prepare their spells in advance.
